notes: Read the 112-line source hook line by line before editing and preserved pushKeys, usePushPublicKey, usePushSubscriptions, useSubscribePush, and useUnsubscribePush behavior.

Ported the non-visual TanStack Query logic to the native web-parity API client while preserving /push/public-key and /push/subscribe paths, GET/POST/DELETE methods, request bodies, stale times, retry=false for the public key query, null-on-404 behavior, and toast key/fallback intent.

Inlined PushSubscriptionRow, PushSubscribeBody, and STALE_TIMES because the native parity layer has no shared web api/types or @/lib/constants alias; browser queryBroadcast is unavailable on native, so invalidation is local TanStack Query cache invalidation.

Documented browserPushManagerAvailable=false because native cannot create the browser PushManager payload in this slice; the server-side hook contract remains available for callers that provide compatible endpoint/key data.
